description: This file defines the AlarmActivity class for an Android application, managing alarm-related functionality via UI buttons that start and stop a repeating alarm service using AlarmManager and PendingIntent.

classes.name: AlarmActivity
classes.description: Main activity controlling alarm start and stop functionalities, handling UI interactions and alarm scheduling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures alarm manager and pending intents.

methods.name: mStartAlarmListener
methods.description: Starts the repeating alarm timer when user clicks start button.

methods.name: mStopAlarmListener
methods.description: Stops the repeating alarm timer when user clicks stop button.
